title: Bind path-UUID payment/booking callbacks to expected tenant ACL before mutation
problem: Authenticated ingress may supply only a payment_id or booking_id path UUID. Handlers currently SELECT the row globally, then treat the row's client_slug as trustedClientSlug without comparing to staff ACL or bot principal-bound tenant. On a shared DB this is a confused-deputy mutate path.

in_scope_handlers.required_control: After resolving payment.client_slug, assertStaffClientAccess(user, clientSlug) before createPaymentLink; optionally scope SELECT with accessible slug or fail closed on deny
Require nonempty boundClientSlug; SELECT payment with AND cl.slug = boundClientSlug (or compare resolved slug === boundClientSlug and 403/404 on mismatch). Never trust object-derived slug alone.
Replace weak user.client_id equality with assertStaffClientAccess(user, booking.client_slug) after scoped lookup

acceptance_tests: RED: staff operator ACL={tenant-alpha} + other-tenant payment UUID → 403 client_access_denied; no Stripe session create; no payment UPDATE
RED: bot boundClientSlug=tenant-alpha + other-tenant payment UUID → 403/404; zero Stripe call; metadata_query does not leak cross-tenant existence beyond uniform miss
RED: staff service-records path with other-tenant booking UUID → 403 before payment insert
GREEN: staff operator with matching ACL + same-tenant payment UUID still creates checkout (idempotent path unchanged)
GREEN: bot boundClientSlug matching payment tenant still creates checkout
GREEN: historical 15A B15 unproven verdict unchanged; 15I overlay + 15J remediation overlay only
out_of_scope: guest GET /pay/:bookingCode short-link default client slug (separate guest surface; SQL already slug-scoped)
must_not: derive trusted tenant solely from object row client_id/slug without ACL/principal compare
